summary: This Standards Track document specifies the MPLS Network Action sub-stack, which carries network actions and ancillary data in the MPLS label stack. These can influence forwarding, carry OAM information, or perform user-defined operations. It updates RFC 9789 to refine the information that must appear in documents defining such actions.

eli5.summary: Packets carry little instruction tags in their label stack, telling routers what extra thing to do.
